name: SAFEOPS
postStartCommand: cd server && (setsid nohup node index.js > /tmp/safeops-server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &) ; disown -a ; sleep 2 ; (curl -sf http://localhost:3000/ > /dev/null && echo '[SAFEOPS] server is up on :3000') || echo '[SAFEOPS] server did not respond — check /tmp/safeops-server.log'
